basic_details.job_title: GSSSB Assistant Technical, Class III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 14 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB), Gandhinagar, has invited applications for 14 posts of Assistant Technical, Class III under Advt No. 469/202627. The online application is open from 25 November 2026 to 9 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only, by debit card, internet banking, UPI or wallet; transaction fee extra. Last date to pay the fee: 12 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university and completed Junior Officer's and Instructors' course at the National Fire Service College; about five years' experience in Fire Brigade service, at least 3 years as sub officer, Leading Fireman or equivalent; basic computer knowledge; prescribed physical and medical standards; adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both.
qualification.details: Qualification: Bachelor's degree from a University established under a Central or State Act in India, or any recognised or deemed University, and completed the Junior Officer's and Instructors' course at the National Fire Service College; Basic knowledge of computer application; Minimum physical and medical standards as in Appendix A of the recruitment rules; Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both Experience: About five years' experience in Fire Brigade service, of which at least 3 years as sub officer, Leading Fireman or equivalent post in Government, Government local body, Government undertaking, Board, Corporation or Companies Act 2013 company, on a post not below the rank of Assistant Technical, Class III Age limit: 18 to 40 years (as on 9 December 2026) Age relaxation: General women 5 years (max 45), Reserved men 5 years (max 45), Reserved women 10 years (max 45), General PwD men 10 years (max 45), General PwD women 15 years (max 45), Reserved PwD men 15 years (max 45), Reserved PwD women 20 years (max 45), Ex-servicemen Service period plus up to 3 years (max 45) | Other conditions: | Citizen of India or nationality as per Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967 Reserved posts and age relaxation are only for reserved-category candidates of Gujarat origin Candidates without a computer certificate may apply but must produce one before appointment Male ST candidates of Gujarat origin: height 160 cm; other male candidates: 165 cm; chest 81 cm deflated, 86 cm inflated; weight 50 kg Physical defects such as knock knee, pigeon chest, squint eye and flat feet make a candidate physically unfit

salary_details.pay_scale: Fixed pay Rs. 40,800 per month for the first five years, then Level-6 Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400 on regular appointment

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking: 1/4 of the marks allotted to the question for each wrong answer Qualifying standard 40% separately in Part-A and Part-B for all categories Provisional answer key published after the exam; final key after objections; cancelled question marks recalculated pro-rata Exam date, time and admit card download will be put on https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in

how_to_apply: Register on OJAS (One Time Registration) at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in if not already registered.
Go to Online Application, click Apply and select GSSSB.
Select Advertisement No. 469/202627, Assistant Technical, Class III, and click Apply now.
Enter registration number and date of birth, click Apply with OTR, fill personal, SSC, bank and educational details.
Accept the declaration, save, and note the Application Number.
Upload photograph and signature (JPG, up to 15 KB).
Confirm the application and note the Confirmation Number.
Pay the fee online by 12-12-2026 and print the application and fee receipt.
important_instructions: Fee is refunded only to candidates who appear in the examination, through the same mode of payment Fee is not refunded if the application is cancelled Only the last confirmed application is valid when more than one is submitted Category cannot be changed after the application is confirmed Helpline for guidance: 079-23258916

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 469/202627 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download GSSSB notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's degree from a University established under a Central or State Act in India, or any recognised or deemed University, and completed the Junior Officer's and Instructors' course at the National Fire Service College; Basic knowledge of computer application; Minimum physical and medical standards as in Appendix A of the recruitment rules; Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both Experience: About five years' experience in Fire Brigade service, of which at least 3 years as sub officer, Leading Fireman or equivalent post in Government, Government local body, Government undertaking, Board, Corporation or Companies Act 2013 company, on a post not below the rank of Assistant Technical, Class III Age limit: 18 to 40 years (as on 9 December 2026) Age relaxation: General women 5 years (max 45), Reserved men 5 years (max 45), Reserved women 10 years (max 45), General PwD men 10 years (max 45), General PwD women 15 years (max 45), Reserved PwD men 15 years (max 45), Reserved PwD women 20 years (max 45), Ex-servicemen Service period plus up to 3 years (max 45) Other conditions: Citizen of India or nationality as per Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967 Reserved posts and age relaxation are only for reserved-category candidates of Gujarat origin Candidates without a computer certificate may apply but must produce one before appointment Male ST candidates of Gujarat origin: height 160 cm; other male candidates: 165 cm; chest 81 cm deflated, 86 cm inflated; weight 50 kg Physical defects such as knock knee, pigeon chest, squint eye and flat feet make a candidate physically unfit

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GSSSB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates currently debarred by GPSC, other recruitment boards or Government bodies Married SEBC women submitting a non-creamy layer certificate based on husband's income: application cancelled

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on fixed pay for the first five years Regular appointment in Level-6 after five years if services are satisfactory, subject to SLP No.14124/2012 and SLP No.14125/2012 judgments Appointed candidates must take government training and pass the training examination

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online only, by debit card, internet banking, UPI or wallet; transaction fee extra. Last date to pay the fee: 12 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will GSSSB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Single-stage MCQ competitive examination (CBRT/OMR) with Part-A and Part-B Provisional answer key, objections, then final answer key Provisional result with separate qualifying standard of 40% in each part About two times the vacancies in each category called for certificate verification Selection list and, where applicable, waiting list by merit Part-A: Reasoning and Data Interpretation 30 marks, Quantitative Aptitude 30 marks, Constitution of India, current affairs, Gujarati and English comprehension 30 marks Part-B: 120 marks on the relevant subject and its application, based on the prescribed educational qualification Widow women candidates and recognised sportspersons get 5 percent of marks added Candidates called for certificate verification: about two times the category-wise vacancies

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Negative marking: 1/4 of the marks allotted to the question for each wrong answer Qualifying standard 40% separately in Part-A and Part-B for all categories Provisional answer key published after the exam; final key after objections; cancelled question marks recalculated pro-rata Exam date, time and admit card download will be put on https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in

content_sections.text: Original certificates for educational qualification, age, school leaving certificate and category (SC/ST/SEBC/EWS) Non-creamy layer or EWS certificate as prescribed, with number and issue date entered in the form Disability certificate (40% or more) in Form V, VI or VII for PwD candidates Ex-serviceman identity card and discharge book Sports certificate in prescribed form where sports marks are claimed Passport-size white background photograph with date, not older than one year before last date

faq.answer: The last date is 9 December 2026. Applications opened on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GSSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies for Assistant Technical, Class III.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GSSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.answer: Unreserved category: Rs. 500. Reserved category (women of all categories, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD, ex-servicemen): Rs. 400.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years (as on 9 December 2026). faq.answer: Fixed pay Rs. 40,800 per month for the first five years, then Level-6 Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400 on regular appointment.

faq.answer: Yes. Citizen of India or nationality as per Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967.
